resources.string: Sign in with Stellar secret key (S…)
Your secret stays on this device only.

Q: How do I create a wallet?
A: Tap Sign up on the login screen (StellarTerm). Create a key pair, save the private key (S…) safely, then paste it here to log in.

Q: How do I buy XLM?
A: On StellarTerm, use the exchange to buy XLM, or send XLM from an exchange to your new Stellar public key (G…).

Q: How do I add the XPi trustline?
A: Open albedo.link → Add trustline → search for XPi from xgoldmining.com → confirm so your wallet can hold XPi rewards.

Q: What is XPI Mining?
A: Lock XLM in a Soroban contract to earn XPi over time.

Q: Minimum stake?
A: 31.4 XLM.

Q: How does the counter work?
A: The live counter is an estimate for UX. Real rewards accrue on-chain; use Claim to receive them.

Q: Is XLM locked?
A: Yes. Unstake returns XLM to your wallet.

Q: Network fees?
A: Each transaction costs a small XLM fee on Stellar.

Q: Is XPi the same as Pi Network?
A: No. XPi is on-chain Stellar crypto you can use right away — not Pi Network.
